caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a rusty, brown-toned iron artifact with two vertical, irregularly shaped legs that have curled tops, resembling scrolls or spirals facing outward. These upright elements are joined by a curved, flat section in the center, which is also brown and textured to indicate corrosion or age. The object is centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background, and is rendered in a realistic style with attention to the rough, pitted surface of the metal. The colors are predominantly various shades of brown, ranging from deep reddish-brown to lighter, almost tan tones, emphasizing the weathered appearance. The drawing is framed by a faint rectangular border, and there are small, unobtrusive handwritten labels on the bottom indicating "FULL SIZE" and the artist's name, "FRANK MAURER."
title: Scraper
